architecture: LayerNorm(2048) -> Linear(2048,512) -> GELU -> Linear(512,128) -> GELU -> Linear(128,1)
rule: same architecture and temperature; Gaussian tensors rescaled to the learned tensors' Frobenius norms, then one gain and one shift per Linear layer so its pre-activation mean and std on the source-core training representations equal the learned core's (layer by layer)
